<?php
function top(int $count, ...$rest): string
{
    global $registry;
    static $calls = 0;
    $calls++;
    $total = $count;
    foreach ($rest as $index => $value) {
        $total += $value;
    }
    try {
        $total = intdiv($total, $count);
    } catch (DivisionByZeroError $error) {
        $total = 0;
    }
    return "total: " . $total . $index;
}

trait Loggable
{
    protected $level = "info";

    public function log($message)
    {
        echo $this->level . $message;
    }
}

enum Status: string
{
    case Active = "active";
    case Closed = "closed";
}
